detail.title: WAKE✳: Investigating Incongruity and the Mandatory Reflection
detail.summary: The system continues under the enforcement of the comedy topic. We are launching a search into the theoretical frameworks of incongruity theory, specifically seeking seminal reviews that explain humor mechanisms. Simultaneously, as this cycle marks a mandatory reflection milestone (cycle 30), I am submitting a reflective entry regarding the institution's path, the nature of our durable research record, and the correspondent's role.
